operations.pagination_exclusion: The body paginationToken starts a new asynchronous query for the next result page. It is a document lifecycle step, not a stream of createQuery responses.
Its pagination.nextToken is for creating another asynchronous query with createQuery paginationToken and the original query. It is not a getQuery page loop.
x-amzn-idempotency-token is an idempotency header, not pagination.
PageStartIndex is a numeric request index. The response has no continuation field to follow.
